details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The predicted year 2019 contradicts the gold target of 1980.
details.groundedness_reasoning: The citation says 2019 had the highest number of reported cases in 23 years, but it does not state that the worldwide peak was in 1980 or provide information from which that year can be derived. None of the other citations identifies 1980 as the year with the highest number of worldwide measles cases. Therefore, a non-trivial fact in the gold target is unsupported.
